lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4Mg2Cu2Sb2S12 (reduced formula Ce2MgCuSbS6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu and Sb centers, each coordinated by six S neighbors, while Ce adopts a close-packed-like arrangement with twelve S neighbors and Mg is four-coordinate to S. Corner-sharing between Cu and Sb octahedra and face-sharing between Ce polyhedra and both Cu and Sb octahedra are observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
